# TurboToolbox — AI OSHA Safety Topics Generator
# https://turbotoolbox.me

## What is TurboToolbox?
TurboToolbox is an AI-powered web application that generates 52 weeks of trade-specific OSHA-compliant toolbox talk safety topics in under 60 seconds. It serves construction, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, welding, and solar contractors with professional-grade PDF safety schedules.

## Key Facts
- Price: $5 one-time payment (no subscription)
- Output: 52-week PDF safety training schedule
- Compliance: OSHA 29 CFR 1926 (Construction) and 29 CFR 1910 (General Industry)
- Standards Referenced: NFPA 70E, ANSI Z10, OSHA General Duty Clause
- Founded: January 2026
- Founded by: James Yaeger, AI student at Illinois Institute of Technology with construction experience

## Supported Trades
- HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning)
- Electrical (Commercial and Residential)
- Plumbing
- Roofing
- Construction (General)
- Welding
- Solar Installation
- Excavation
- Masonry

## How It Works
1. User enters company name, trade, and start date
2. AI generates 52 unique, trade-specific safety training topics
3. Each topic includes a Crew Handout (fast facts, PPE, hazards, checklist, incident briefing) and a Foreman Guide (talking points, engagement questions)
4. Complete PDF with cover page, table of contents, and signature attendance log
5. Download immediately — print and distribute to crew

## Why Contractors Use It
- Eliminates hours of manual safety topic research
- Provides documented proof of training for OSHA inspections
- Each PDF includes crew sign-off sheets for compliance records
- Averts fines averaging $16,550 per serious OSHA violation
- ROI: $5 investment vs potential $16,550+ per violation
